translations.web: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
translations.bsb: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and afterward he may reenter the camp.
translations.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
